description: This source file defines extension methods for setting up NATS streaming integration within an Orleans silo builder. It provides methods to configure silo to use NATS persistent streams with specified options or configurators.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure NATS streaming in an Orleans silo.

methods.name: AddNatsStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to add and configure NATS persistent streams using specified options.
